question: Which project should I inspect first?
lead: That depends on the discipline you seek to evaluate. Nhovem engineers real-time interactive canvas engines, distributed enterprise systems, client-side hardened vaults, native Android utilities, and private full-stack mobile apps.

inquiries.label: Show me real-time interactive canvas gameplay
inquiries.response: Inspect Arcane Typer. A fast-paced HTML5 Canvas typing engine built entirely solo, featuring 60 FPS rendering, custom keystroke telemetry, and an in-page live simulation arena.

inquiries.label: Show me large-scale enterprise system design
inquiries.response: Inspect BITS. A production biometric attendance system built over six months with a team of eight. Nhovem built the overtime processing engine, biometric check-in flow, and multi-shift normalization layers.

inquiries.label: Show me security & offline vault architecture
inquiries.response: Inspect Mimic. An Android party game engineered around an isolated, client-side AES-256 encrypted personal vault.

inquiries.label: Show me private full-stack E2EE mobile architecture
inquiries.response: Inspect The Nest. A private two-person Expo/React Native and Fastify/PostgreSQL companion featuring passwordless native keystore custody, double-ratchet E2EE chat, and EXIF-stripped presigned uploads.

inquiries.label: Show me native Android game booster & Shizuku tuning
inquiries.response: Inspect TaDuwa. A native Java 17 Android game booster, companion, and recorder starting with Mobile Legends and expanding to all apps—featuring MediaProjection game audio capture, a floating Pop Icon, and optional non-root Shizuku controls.
